procedures.name: multinomial regression nowcast (with doubling times from model growth rates)
procedures.inferred_from: 'multinomial regression' for nowcasts → logistic family (multinomial); doubling times derived from the model coefficients

ev.q: To estimate variant proportions for the most recent 3 weeks, nowcasts were generated using multinomial regression fit on the previous 21 weeks of data.
Doubling times for proportions of specific lineages were estimated from the coefficients of the multinomial nowcasting model.
